US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth has avoided an immediate impeachment push after 11 Democratic lawmakers missed a crucial vote in the House of Representatives. The lawmakers are facing criticism within their own party, with questions being raised about their absence. The impeachment resolution, introduced by Republican Congressman Thomas Massie, accused Hegseth of multiple violations related to US military operations. Here's what happened during the vote, who the 11 Democrats are and what the allegations against Hegseth involve.
